name: 1:1 check-in
description: Capture priorities, feedback, support needs, and commitments from a one-to-one meeting.

sections.title: Check-in
sections.instruction: Summarize how each person described their current workload and priorities. Attribute views to the speaker and cite the supplied source tags

sections.title: Feedback and support
sections.instruction: List specific feedback, examples, blockers, and requests for support. Keep feedback separate from commitments and cite the supplied source tag for each point

sections.title: Action items
sections.instruction: List agreed follow-ups. Copy the supplied source tag beside each task and include owners or dates only when explicitly stated
sections.item_format: - Task in one sentence. Owner: name or Unassigned; Due: date or Not specified

sections.title: Topics to revisit
sections.instruction: List concerns or questions left open, using only the supplied source tags that support them
